response: Saved Views is available today for all customers. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you check on a project, you can now save any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a named view that stays ready whenever you need it. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team already on a paid subscription can start using it right away without any additional cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to create dedicated views for different projects, clients, sprints, or personal workflows. Once you've built a view that works well, you can share it with your team so everyone sees the same filtered list without having to recreate your setup. Shared views make it easier to align on priorities, track specific issue types, or keep an eye on deadlines together. We think this small addition will make your daily work noticeably more organized. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
